prompt_text: Who is the best dentist in Chicago for a dental implant?
answer_verbatim:
“Best” depends on what matters most to you (training, experience with complex cases, sedation, price, insurance, location). I can find specific names, but first it helps to clarify a few things so I can recommend the right specialists:

Quick questions
- Do you need a single implant, multiple implants, or a full-arch (All‑on‑4) solution?
- Any medical issues (diabetes, smoking, history of radiation) or need for bone grafting/sinus lift?
- Do you prefer an oral surgeon, periodontist, or prosthodontist? (Or do you want a practice that offers all three specialties together?)
- What neighborhood or zip code in Chicago is most convenient?
- Are you using insurance or need financing?

How to pick the “best” implant dentist in Chicago
- Look for the right specialist(s): oral and maxillofacial surgeons (surgery/complex cases), periodontists (gums and implants), and prosthodontists (restoration/crowns/bridges). Many complex implant cases are done by a team (surgeon/periodontist + prosthodontist).
- Board certification and training: check for ABOMS (oral surgeons), ABP (periodontists/prosthodontists) or similar credentials and hospital privileges.
- Experience: ask how many implants they place per year and how many years of experience with the specific procedure you need.
- Technology and planning: look for CBCT (3D imaging), guided/digital implant planning, in‑house CAD/CAM prosthetics, and experience with high‑quality implant systems (Straumann, Nobel Biocare, etc.).
- Before/after cases and references: request photos and patient references for similar cases.
- Complication rate and warranty: ask how complications are handled and what the follow-up/guarantee policy is.
- Reviews and professional affiliations: check Google/Yelp, Healthgrades, and membership in ADA, AAOMS, AAP (periodontists), or ACP (prosthodontists).
- Location, sedation options, financing and timeline: verify sedation/anesthesia options, estimated timeline, and cost/financing.

If you want, I can:
- Search for top-rated implant specialists in Chicago near your zip code;
- Provide a short list of highly reviewed oral surgeons/periodontists/prosthodontists and their contact info;
- Or help draft a list of questions to ask at a consultation.

Which would you like me to do? If you want names, tell me your zip code and any preferences (e.g., price, sedation, same‑day).
